title: Campaign Performance Report
subtitle: Transform raw campaign data into a visual story that drives the Q4 budget decision.
ai_tool: Any AI tool (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini)

data_files.role: Genpact Enterprise Intelligence Suite launch — $1.72M spend across 6 channels, 1,847 leads, 67 opportunities vs 150 target (44.7% attainment), cost-per-opportunity by channel, monthly trend, audience segment breakdown

learning_objectives: Attach a campaign dataset and let the AI read every spend figure and conversion rate — your job is budget judgment, not data lookup

Write the five things a spreadsheet cannot tell an AI: who is making the Q4 decision, what verdict the data supports, what the hidden insight is, where the Q4 money should go, and what the single biggest bet is
Specify a channel comparison chart sorted by cost per opportunity so the best-to-worst gap is visually dramatic — not buried in a table
Iterate with precision: name the single most important gap in your first output and fix only that in one follow-up
Deliver a decision-ready campaign postmortem that replaces a 20-slide deck with one interactive HTML file — no server, no install, no dependencies
deliverable: Single-file interactive HTML campaign performance report
